title: Seedbed rollout schematic and 7-day runway notes
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, operational-focused sketch for the 'seedbed' rollout. Goal: validate model routing + prefix caching heuristic under realistic traffic while preserving latency SLOs and cost targets. Use as a hands-on checklist for a 7-day runway (canary -> ramp -> steady). Keep it intentionally rough — this lives on Drive as the working notes for the ops team.

High-level plan (7-day runway, UTC):
- Day 0 (2026-07-27): Preflight + smoke; prune old staging routes; deploy variant v2.1-canary (5% global traffic, region filter: us-west only)
- Day 1: Monitor cohort, validate latency p50/p95, KV cache hit-rate sampling. Keep canary at 5% if stable.
- Day 2: Expand canary to 15% and enable prefix cache warmup for hot endpoints. Verify per-route cost delta < 12%
- Day 3-4: Regional ramp to 40% with autoscaling watch. Run synthetic load tests during quiet-window (02:00-04:00 UTC)
- Day 5: Soft roll to 70% with fallback policy turned on (auto-fallback to v2.0 if error spike > 1.5x baseline)
- Day 6: Full route switch to v2.1 in non-critical regions; maintain 20% reserve capacity for burst
- Day 7: Finalize rollout, capture release notes and metric snapshots, schedule post-rollout retro

Quick preflight checklist (owner initials):
- [ ] Canary bundle built and verified: sha present in ci-artifacts (Asha)
- [ ] Nightly smoke suite green on staging and canary image (Marco)
- [ ] Telemetry hooks installed: token-level cost, model-id, batch-size tags (Lena)
- [ ] Alert burn-in thresholds reviewed and adjusted (SRE)
- [ ] Runbook updated: rollback snippet and contact on-call (Rajiv)

Canary signals to watch (thresholds are provisional):
- Latency: p50 <= 85ms, p95 <= 320ms (if p95 > 450ms -> immediate rollback)
- Error rate: 5xx rate < 0.2% absolute increase over baseline
- Cost: per-token cost delta < 20% normalized by token length (hourly check)
- Quality: automated prompt set UID=seedbed-smoke; semantic drift score < 0.03
- Cache: prefix/KV hit-rate improves response tail; if miss-rate increases > 10% raise an investigation ticket

Rollback decision matrix (fast paths):
- Fatal latency or error spike -> full rollback to pinned v2.0 and page on-call SRE
- Partial degradation (region-only) -> regional rollback, route traffic away using smart-routing policy A
- Cost blowout -> pause rollout, reduce batch-size suggestion from Optimize, re-evaluate quantization profile

Operator play snippets (copy for Slack/email):
- Preflight announcement: "Deploying v2.1-canary to us-west (5%) at 2026-07-27 09:00 UTC. Watch latency p95 and 5xx alerts. Ping #release-ops if any anomalies."
- Rollout update: "Canary expanded to 15% — telemetry stable. Continuing ramp plan. See metrics at /dash/release/seedbed"

Release notes draft (to paste into release ticket):
- Feature: Routing improvements that enable adaptive prefix caching and reduced per-token compute for recurrent queries
- Fix: KV cache eviction bug under high concurrency (regression from v2.0 patch)
- Opt: New kernel selection heuristic for short-context responses; expected latency wins for sub-128 tokens
- Known issue: Small percentage of long-context (>2048) responses may see slightly higher p95 during initial warmup; automatic fallback enabled

Post-roll requirements:
- Snapshot metrics (UTC timestamps): latencies, 5xx counts, cost per 1M tokens, cache hit-rate (Asha)
- Feed prompt-eval harness with sampled user queries from canary cohort (Lena)
- Fill retro template within 48h and capture 'what surprised us' section (Rajiv)

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Do we want an explicit wallet cap on dedicated instances for this rollout? If so, add billing guard in console.
- Confirm with Product whether the quality regression threshold of 0.03 is acceptable; maybe loosen for experimental cohorts.
- Add a short smoke test for streaming truncation edge-case (PR 4723 referenced above)

Quick links and tickets:
- Confluence 'seedbed' spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RELEASE/seedbed
- Rolling test job: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/actions/runs/205721
- Primary rollout ticket: JIRA-RELEASE-1123

Notes end. Save as working draft. If nothing breaks by Day 3, I'll promote to 'in_review' and ask Product for final sign-off on release notes.
